title: 第1章 一夜疯狂
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
这女人看起来，大他十八岁吧。

    陈阳此刻傻愣愣地瘫坐在床上，直直盯着身前的被子。

    昨天是他好兄弟李恒和宋萌萌的婚礼，他在酒店婚宴上喝得酩酊大醉。

    李恒就在酒店给他开了房。

    在他迷迷糊糊走到房间门口时，就看到一个穿着红裙的女人跌跌撞撞走来，浑身带着酒气与香水味。

    没等他反应，她就直直扑进他怀里，声音软糯又迷离：“救我……我好难受……”

    陈阳借着走廊的灯光，看到她那张满是风韵的脸。

    她迷离的双眼像蒙了一层水雾，脸颊绯红而撩人。

    陈阳仅在的理智逐渐瓦解，在要失控的边缘，却猛地想起自己女友唐欣悦。

    陈阳浑身一震，一下用力推开她：“阿姨，别这样，我们不能……”

    女人却像没听见。

    陈阳知道不能对不起女友，就拼命挣脱开她，转身就想进浴室洗冷水澡清醒一下，可醉酒的身体不听使唤，脚下一滑，“扑通”一声摔在地上……

    陈阳此时看着身旁熟睡的女人。

    只见他长长的睫毛垂着，像覆了一层薄纱，鼻梁高挺，唇瓣饱满，即使在睡梦中，也带着几分成熟女人的慵懒韵味。

    她约莫四十岁上下，但保养极好，肌肤白皙细腻，眼角虽有淡淡的细纹，却更添高贵典雅，一身与生俱来的贵气，丝毫掩饰不住。

    陈阳定了定神，又转头看向被子，双眼一凝，那透明感再次浮现，被底下的景象又清晰起来。

    可下一秒，一阵晕眩猛地袭来。

    他下意识地扶了扶额头，透视感瞬间消失，被子恢复了原样。
content_en:
This woman looks to be eighteen years older than him.

Chen Yang was sitting on the bed stupidly, staring at the quilt in front of him.

Yesterday was the wedding of his good brothers Li Heng and Song Mengmeng. He was extremely drunk at the hotel wedding banquet.

Li Heng booked a room for him in the hotel.

When he walked to the door of the room in a daze, he saw a woman in a red dress stumbling over, smelling of wine and perfume.

Before he could react, she threw herself into his arms, her voice soft and confused: "Help me... I feel so uncomfortable..."

Chen Yang used the light in the corridor to see her charming face.

Her blurred eyes seemed to be covered with a layer of mist, and her cheeks were blushing and sultry.

Chen Yang's only rationality gradually collapsed, and on the verge of losing control, he suddenly thought of his girlfriend Tang Xinyue.

Chen Yang was shocked and pushed her away: "Auntie, don't be like this, we can't..."

The woman didn't seem to hear her.

Chen Yang knew that he could not be sorry for his girlfriend, so he struggled to get away from her. He turned around and wanted to go into the bathroom and take a cold shower to sober up. However, his drunken body refused to obey his control. His foot slipped and he fell to the ground with a "plop"...

Chen Yang looked at the sleeping woman next to him.

His long eyelashes were hanging down, as if covered with a layer of gauze, his nose bridge was high, and his lips were full. Even in his sleep, he had the lazy charm of a mature woman.

She is about forty years old, but her skin is extremely well-maintained and her skin is fair and delicate. Although there are faint fine lines at the corners of her eyes, they add to her nobility and elegance. Her innate nobility cannot be concealed at all.

Chen Yang calmed down and turned to look at the quilt again. His eyes condensed, and the sense of transparency reappeared, and the scene under the quilt became clear again.

But the next second, a wave of dizziness hit him suddenly.

He subconsciously held his forehead, the sense of perspective disappeared instantly, and the quilt returned to its original state.
